cases.label: 45 CFR 164 (HIPAA Security Rule) — returns valid as-of date and section count
cases.note: Requires outbound HTTPS to ecfr.gov; may return cached result if API is unavailable

cases.label: Nonexistent CFR part — returns error, not fabricated section data
cases.note: CFR title 99 part 9999 does not exist; must return error object, never a fabricated as_of_date or section_count

cases.label: since_date in the future — changed is always false
cases.note: No CFR part can have an as-of date in the future; changed must be false
